description: Thin catalog mapping weapon IDs to the Blueprint primary asset (weapon actor class) that implements each weapon.

ID.technical: FName row key, e.g. WP_010_00. Consumers reach it through a cross-table join: CharacterVariation.Id_CharacterWeapon -> CharacterWeapon.Id_Weapon[i] -> WeaponDataTables (+0x6B0); NAME_None entries are skipped. Capture code also reaches it from SituationOverviewPose animation weapon IDs. The first matching table containing the key wins.

FileName_BP.simple: Name of the weapon's Blueprint asset.
FileName_BP.technical: FName key of the Character/Weapon primary asset loader (export rows use <ID>_BP, e.g. WP_010_00_BP; 20 rows). Battle phase and capture code resolve it to a UClass and spawn an AGameWeapon at the socket from CharacterWeapon.SocketName[i]; the boot asset collector appends it to the preload list; the capture loader list uses FindChecked (missing asset is fatal). Capture preload also de-duplicates pose weapons by case-insensitive FileName_BP prefix. No per-field default beyond FName's NAME_None is set by the constructor.

notes: Asset registration: GameDataTableManager.cpp:237 resolves 'WeaponDataTable' into WeaponDataTables at +0x6B0; the loader name is registered at GameDataTableManager.cpp:409. CharacterWeaponDataTable (+0x4E0) is a separate table and owns socket/visibility data; WeaponDataTable only names the weapon Blueprint.

Only the two fields above exist in the reconstructed row struct and in all 20 exported rows. There are no behavioural parameters (damage, timing, motion) in this table; those live in other tables/Blueprints.

Available sources show four consumer families: battle boot asset preload, live battle spawn, level-sequence setup, and character capture/situation-overview setup. Unreal Blueprints are not available here, so their internal use of weapon classes is out of scope.

usages.detail: Loads the WeaponDataTable asset into the manager's WeaponDataTables array (+0x6B0).
BattleAssets_Weapons joins CharacterWeapon rows to Weapon rows and adds each FileName_BP to the preload output list (retail 0x12bd080).
Battle spawn path resolves WeaponRow.FileName_BP through StudioWeaponLoaders_900, spawns the weapon class at the configured socket, applies map lighting and initial active/hidden state.
Cutscene/level-sequence setup resolves the same row through FindChecked, spawns the weapon and applies map lighting.
Capture setup checks already-carried weapons, resolves the row's FileName_BP through the capture slot's WeaponLoaders and spawns the missing weapon.
Capture preload gathers weapon loader names from pose rows, using FileName_BP prefixes to suppress duplicate weapon families.
